component.name: Autofisher-3000
component.summary: Wayland-native World of Warcraft fishing bot

description.p: A fishing bot for World of Warcraft that works on a native Wayland session. It captures the game window through the XDG ScreenCast portal, locates the bobber with a YOLO11-n ONNX model, and casts and reels through the XDG RemoteDesktop portal.
Because capture and input both go through desktop portals, the sandbox needs no display socket, no PipeWire socket, and no network access.
